title: OpenHome: From Perception to Insight in Smart-Home Camera Videos
abstract: arXiv:2610.31986v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Vision language models (VLMs) have been increasingly adopted in consumer smart-home camera systems to interpret recorded videos and provide insights. However, video clips captured from smart-home cameras are different from curated web videos dominating existing VLM benchmarks. Smart-home video clips often do not contain subtitles or narration and are captured from different viewing angles, under various lighting conditions, and in diverse scenarios. However, the capabilities of the model in this domain, under sparse visual signals and limited context, are not fully assessed by existing VLM benchmarks. To close this gap, we introduce OpenHome, a visual-only, four-option multiple-choice benchmark for evaluating smart-home video understanding. It contains 2,254 questions on 1,118 real-world video clips and organizes 10 tasks into three capability levels. Perception evaluates visible content, Reasoning evaluates causal, spatial, and tempor

translated_title: OpenHome：从感知到洞察的智能家居摄像头视频
translated_abstract: 视觉语言模型（VLMs）在消费级智能家居摄像头系统中被越来越多地采用，用于解读录制的视频并提供洞察。然而，从智能家居摄像头捕获的视频片段与现有VLM基准测试中占主导地位的精选网络视频有所不同。智能家居视频片段通常不包含字幕或旁白，并且是在不同的视角、各种光照条件以及多样化的场景下捕获的。然而，模型在该领域在稀疏视觉信号和有限上下文情况下的能力，尚未被现有的VLM基准测试充分评估。为了弥合这一差距，我们提出了OpenHome，这是一个用于评估智能家居视频理解的纯视觉四选一多选题基准测试。它包含针对1,118个真实世界视频片段的2,254个问题，并将10个任务组织为三个能力层级。感知层级评估可见内容，推理层级评估因果、空间和时间……
tldr: 该论文提出了OpenHome，一个包含2,254个问题、覆盖1,118个真实智能家居视频片段的纯视觉多选题基准测试，用于在稀疏视觉信号和有限上下文条件下系统评估视觉语言模型的智能家居视频理解能力。
